shrtft1.note: Widened from OBD nominal [-100, 99.22] to accommodate OBD rail/sensor-fault sentinel values (-127, +127). Rail values are a sensor_fault signal consumed by COMLab trim-evidence scoring.

longft1.note: Widened from OBD nominal [-100, 99.22] to accommodate OBD rail/sensor-fault sentinel values (-127, +127).

shrtft2.note: Only validated when number_of_banks == 2. Must be null when number_of_banks == 1. Widened to accommodate OBD rail values.

longft2.note: Only validated when number_of_banks == 2. Must be null when number_of_banks == 1. Widened to accommodate OBD rail values.

control_module_voltage_v.note: Supply voltage at the PCM pins per OBDLab_KG_Wiki.md §3.1 / ecu-diagnosis/09.

bank_2_null_contract.rule: shrtft2 and longft2 must be null (not 0.0) when number_of_banks == 1. Emitting 0.0 for absent bank fields is a SEMANTIC_CONTRACT violation.
